decisions.reason: The operator line complements the core garage door range and benefited from strong residential demand through 2021, so results likely met aspirations and give no reason to search for other uses of its resources.
The solid wood door is a low-visibility niche variant that may underperform, but it adds breadth to the one-source range at modest cost, and slack from the housing boom lets the firm carry it.
The remote-control operator supports door sales and comfort demand, but it may be absorbed into the broader operator line A, which leaves a moderate risk of consolidation.
After dropping the overlapping Product F, this glazed industrial door remains a standard part of the industrial portfolio, although further rationalisation of overlapping variants is possible.
The insulated glazed variant meets tightening energy-efficiency demands, so its performance likely meets aspirations and justifies keeping it.
